headline: Nvidia, Palantir Pull Back From Anthropic Models Over Fears AI Could Expose Corporate Secrets
summary: Nvidia and Palantir are limiting some Anthropic AI use over fears sensitive corporate data could leak or train outside models.

headline: Palantir Stock Rises as AI Leaders Hint at Growth Slowdown
summary: Palantir Technologies shares are climbing Monday after AI executives signaled industry growth may slow, easing pressure on software vendors.
